# victorops_routing_keys (Data Source)

Get all routing keys for the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "victorops_routing_keys" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Optional filter pattern to match routing key names (supports * wildcard).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `routing_keys` (List of Object) The routing keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_keys))
